name: OpenSea
rootCause: According to news, the security research company discovered that there is a serious security vulnerability in OpenSea in the NFT market, which may cause hackers to steal the user's entire encrypted wallet. Then OpenSea responded that a repair was implemented within one hour of discovering the problem, and other measures will be taken to strengthen community safety education.
